answer_1.quote: We evaluate both the base and finetuned versions of VLMs using MMHalBench, Object HalBench, and AMBER, which are standard benchmarks for assessing hallucination and the quality of generated text of VLMs.
answer_1.outputs: textual answers/descriptions generated by VLMs in response to image‑question pairs

answer_2.quote: We report the CHAIR metric to measure object hallucination and the MMHalBench score (computed via ) to quantify the quality of generated outputs. Additional scores such as HalRate and GPT‑score are also reported.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation using 80 randomly selected image-question pairs, 40 from the AMBER benchmark and 40 from the Object HalBench. Each pair is presented to three crowd workers recruited via Amazon Mechanical Turk... Workers are instructed to select the response that is more accurate and reliable, considering the visual information in the image.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators choose which of two model responses is more accurate and reliable based on the visual information; a tie option is provided if both are identical or incorrect.
